UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User account preferences and theme selection stored per authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document owner.

displayName.description: Display name shown on the Perfil screen.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

UserTrack.title: UserTrack
UserTrack.description: User track metadata and favorite status synced to the cloud.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document owner.

favorite.description: Whether the user marked the track as favorite.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

UserPlaylist.title: UserPlaylist
UserPlaylist.description: Custom user playlist storing ordered track IDs synced to the cloud.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the playlist owner.

description.description: Optional short description of the playlist.

trackIds.description: Ordered list of track IDs contained in the playlist.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

CatalogArtist.title: CatalogArtist
CatalogArtist.description: Shared cloud catalog artist managed by the verified admin and readable by signed-in users when published.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin creator.

bio.description: Short artist biography or genre tags.

photoUrl.description: HTTPS download URL of artist photo in Firebase Storage, or empty string.

published.description: Whether this artist is visible to all signed-in users.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

CatalogAlbum.title: CatalogAlbum
CatalogAlbum.description: Shared cloud catalog album linked to an artist.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin creator.

artistId.description: Document ID of the parent CatalogArtist.

coverUrl.description: HTTPS download URL of album cover in Firebase Storage, or empty string.

published.description: Whether this album is visible to all signed-in users.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

CatalogTrack.title: CatalogTrack
CatalogTrack.description: Shared cloud catalog audio track playable via streaming or offline download.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin creator.

artistId.description: Document ID of the parent CatalogArtist.

albumId.description: Document ID of the CatalogAlbum, or empty string for singles.

albumTitle.description: Album title or empty string for singles.

trackNumber.description: Track order within the album or release.

audioUrl.description: HTTPS download URL of the audio file in Firebase Storage.

coverUrl.description: HTTPS download URL of the cover art or empty string.

published.description: Whether this track is visible to all signed-in users.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

AppReleaseConfig.title: AppReleaseConfig
AppReleaseConfig.description: Latest GitHub Release version metadata published by Admin for in-app update notifications.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who published the release.

latestVersionCode.description: Latest Android versionCode available for download.

downloadUrl.description: HTTPS GitHub Release URL for the updated APK.

releaseNotes.description: Summary of improvements and changes in the release.

mandatory.description: Whether the update dialog should hide the dismiss button.

CommunityTrackStats.title: CommunityTrackStats
CommunityTrackStats.description: Aggregated community play counts and quick emoji reactions per catalog track.

trackId.description: Track identifier matching the document ID.

playCount.description: Total community plays for this track.

UserTrackReaction.title: UserTrackReaction
UserTrackReaction.description: Per-user toggle state for fire, heart, and headphones reactions on a track.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the reacting user.

trackId.description: Track identifier matching the document ID.

fire.description: Whether the user reacted with fire.

heart.description: Whether the user reacted with heart.

headphones.description: Whether the user reacted with headphones.

JamSession.title: JamSession
JamSession.description: Real-time shared listening room synchronized by a 6-character code.

roomCode.description: 6-character uppercase room code matching the document ID.

hostUserId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room host.

hostName.description: Display name of the room host.

currentTrackId.description: Currently playing track ID or empty string.

positionMs.description: Last synced playback position in milliseconds.

queueTrackIds.description: Shared Jam queue of upcoming track IDs.

active.description: Whether the Jam room is still active.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp on last playback or queue update.

SharedPlaylist.title: SharedPlaylist
SharedPlaylist.description: Shareable or collaborative playlist accessible by a 6-character code.

shareCode.description: 6-character uppercase share code matching the document ID.

ownerUserId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the playlist owner.

ownerName.description: Display name of the playlist owner.

trackIds.description: Ordered list of track IDs in the shared playlist.

collaborative.description: Whether other signed-in users with the code can add tracks.

UserArtistFollow.title: UserArtistFollow
UserArtistFollow.description: Per-user record indicating that the user follows a catalog artist.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the follower.

artistId.description: CatalogArtist document ID matching the follow doc ID.

followedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user followed the artist.

ArtistStats.title: ArtistStats
ArtistStats.description: Aggregated follower count per catalog artist.

artistId.description: CatalogArtist document ID matching this document ID.

followerCount.description: Total community followers for this artist.

TrackComment.title: TrackComment
TrackComment.description: Timestamped community comment pinned to a specific playback second of a track.

trackId.description: Track identifier the comment belongs to.

trackTitle.description: Denormalized track title for moderation display.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the comment author.

authorName.description: Display name of the comment author.

timestampMs.description: Playback timestamp in milliseconds where the comment is anchored.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document holding app theme preference.

/users/{userId}/tracks/{trackId}.description: User-scoped library tracks and favorite state.

/users/{userId}/playlists/{playlistId}.description: User-scoped custom playlists with ordered track IDs.

/catalog_artists/{artistId}.description: Global cloud catalog of artists published by Admin.

/catalog_albums/{albumId}.description: Global cloud catalog of albums published by Admin.

/catalog_tracks/{trackId}.description: Global cloud catalog of songs published by Admin for streaming and offline download.

/app_config/{configId}.description: App release configuration document (release) for GitHub Releases update alerts.

/community_stats/{trackId}.description: Community play counts and quick reactions powering Trending in AMDV-TUNE.

/artist_stats/{artistId}.description: Community follower counts per catalog artist.

/track_comments/{commentId}.description: Timestamped community comments on songs, moderated by author or Admin.

/jam_sessions/{roomCode}.description: Live synchronized listening rooms joined via 6-character code.

/shared_playlists/{shareCode}.description: Shareable and collaborative playlists accessed via 6-character code.
